method.model: same configured model and reasoning for both revisions
method.timing: Receipt timestamps include reply queue; necessary first/all confirmations separate from optional attachments and later history commit
method.reply_queue_metric: Initial reply execution admission wait; later model queues and suspension/resumption remain included in end-to-end receipt timing, not added to initial admission
method.provider_event_metric: Provider wrapper elapsed includes SDK wire-admission waits, retry/backoff, preparation and cleanup on the native SDK path; not socket-only or generation-only time
method.attempt_count: 2280 counts reply tasks across both revisions, not billable model API calls; one task may perform generation, prediction, review and retries.
method.input_clock: Case text, prior context and sampling seed are fixed; runtime receipt/recency timestamps use the advancing clock and are not bit-identical across runs
method.summary_population: Confirmed necessary answers with history commit; failed/cancelled/unknown counts retained, 30s rate uses all attempts
method.faults: Controlled slow tool, repeated review,429,slow ledger and delayed simulated receipt; separate from ordinary cases
limitations: Simulated QQ receipts do not establish real network latency
Semantic judge is an independent model assessment, not human certification
Live service remained enabled; remote model load may vary
Timed fixtures are synthetic group messages; private-message behavior is covered by regressions, not a separate paired network-latency series
The isolated replay loads the persistent idle-learning queue but does not start its worker; it does not measure end-to-end latency with background learning actively running in that replay process
Private provider/persona configuration and raw conversations are not published; these timings are not a guarantee for public installation defaults
Earlier candidate experiments remain local and are not mixed into this final-source series

paired_quality.category_note: Descriptive breakdown of the same frozen judgments. Failed sends remain zero; this does not replace or relax the original overall acceptance gate.

host_conditions.limitation: Readiness checked before each run, not continuously enforced; other applications are never stopped or modified

adaptive_recovery_diagnostic.kind: isolated deterministic state-machine diagnostic, no model calls or sends
adaptive_recovery_diagnostic.finding: The per-minute minimum of 20 completed calls cannot be reached by a fully occupied one-slot source with four-second calls; recovery stays sample-starved even after cooldown.
adaptive_recovery_diagnostic.limitation: Shows recovery gating only. Does not prove the initial production downshift cause or predict actual remote latency.

hold_reason_diagnostic.actual_hold_condition: Execution P95 exceeds baseline by more than10% but less than20%; neither increase nor decrease qualifies
hold_reason_diagnostic.finding: The no-change branch retains an earlier insufficient-samples reason instead of explaining the current hold condition

early_rate_limit_diagnostic.finding: An early429 reduces to one slot before baseline2 exists. Only two-slot windows can establish baseline2, so recovery remains blocked despite ample fast successful samples and elapsed cooldown.
